name: engine-stripping
title: Engine stripping: build a game's player without the engine modules it does not use (3D physics backends, 2D physics first)
issue: User request, 2026-11-08: 'make engine stripping when engines are not used, for example if a game doesn't use physics or doesn't use 2D physics in particular'. Design first: orchestrator/proposals/engine-stripping-design.md, which has the open decisions. Implements J10 of the physics plan as part of it.
acceptance: A web package can be built with each listed module left out; each configuration is built and smoke-tested in CI
A stripped player given a scene that needs a stripped module fails with a clear message at package time, and at run time if it gets that far
The measured size of each configuration is recorded; the full build's behaviour and budgets are unchanged
gate: user decisions in engine-stripping-design.md; after box2d-p2-module
notes: Reviewer: a stripped module leaves no symbols behind, a full build is unchanged, and the network fingerprint is defined for a stripped player.
